results.title: Brain region identification
results.question: What are the major subdivisions of the Drosophila mushroom body?
results.response: The major subdivisions of the Drosophila [mushroom body](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00005801 "Open mushroom body in Virtual Fly Brain") are the calyx, pedunculus, and mushroom body lobe system, as stated in the VFB database. According to VFB, the mushroom body is divided into these three parts, with the calyx receiving sensory interneuron afferents, the pedunculus being a thick axon bundle extending from the calyx to the base of the lobes, and the mushroom body lobe system consisting of a vertical branch and a medial branch, which have different structures at different life stages. VFB holds various data related to the mushroom body, including images, neuron information, parts, and subclasses, with specific counts available, such as [602](https://v2.virtualflybrain.org/org.geppetto.frontend/geppetto?q=FBbt_00005801,NeuronsPartHere "Run in VFB: Neurons with some part in mushroom body") neurons with some part in mushroom body and [176](https://v2.virtualflybrain.org/org.geppetto.frontend/geppetto?q=FBbt_00005801,PartsOf "Run in VFB: Parts of mushroom body") parts of mushroom body.

results.title: Neuron type classification
results.question: What types of Kenyon cells exist in the adult Drosophila brain?
results.response:
The adult Drosophila brain contains several types of Kenyon cells, including gamma Kenyon cells. VFB records show that there are several subclasses of Kenyon cells, including alpha/beta, alpha'/beta', and gamma Kenyon cells, which are further subdivided into subtypes. The connectome data indicates that gamma Kenyon cells are a specific type of Kenyon cell that innervates the gamma lobe in the adult brain. VFB holds [10](https://v2.virtualflybrain.org/org.geppetto.frontend/geppetto?q=FBbt_00100247,SubclassesOf "Run in VFB: Subclasses of gamma Kenyon cell") records of subclasses of gamma Kenyon cells, which include [larval [gamma Kenyon cell](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00100247 "Open gamma Kenyon cell in Virtual Fly Brain")](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00049827 "Open larval gamma Kenyon cell in Virtual Fly Brain"), [KCg-s](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00049830 "Open KCg-s in Virtual Fly Brain"), [KCg-s4](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00049832 "Open KCg-s4 in Virtual Fly Brain"), [KCg-t](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00049833 "Open KCg-t in Virtual Fly Brain"), [KCg-d](https://www.virtualflybrain.org/reports/FBbt_00110932 "Open KCg-d in Virtual Fly Brain"), KCg-m, KCg-s1, KCg-s2, KCg, and KCg-s3. 

To learn more about the gamma Kenyon cell, you can explore the available VFB data, such as images, splits targeting gamma Kenyon cell, scRNAseq data, transgene expression, downstream connectivity classes, and upstream connectivity classes.

VFB records show that the giant fiber neuron has specific anatomy, including a large cell body located posterior to the lower protocerebrum, and a large descending axon that enters the cervical connective via the posterior cerebro-cervical fascicle. The axon descends on the ipsilateral side in the dorsal cervical fasciculus. In the brain, the giant fiber neuron has dendritic arborization in the ipsilateral zones A and B of the antennal mechanosensory and motor center, where it receives substantial input from zone A and B Johnston organ neurons. It also arborizes in the posterior ventrolateral protocerebrum and gorget. 

The connectivity data indicates that the giant fiber neuron receives input from zone A and B Johnston organ neurons and has downstream and upstream connectivity classes, with VFB holding [389](https://v2.virtualflybrain.org/org.geppetto.frontend/geppetto?q=FBbt_00004020,DownstreamClassConnectivity "Run in VFB: Downstream connectivity classes for DNp01") records of downstream connectivity classes and [472](https://v2.virtualflybrain.org/org.geppetto.frontend/geppetto?q=FBbt_00004020,UpstreamClassConnectivity "Run in VFB: Upstream connectivity classes for DNp01") records of upstream connectivity classes for DNp01.
